sentences.text: In economics, economic growth is an increase in the quantity and quality of the economic goods and services that a society produces.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

objectsOrComplements.text: an increase in the quantity and quality of the economic goods and services that a society produces

sentences.readingHintZh: 先找主语候选“economic growth”，再看句法中心“is”。再读与中心词连接的宾语或补语候选“an increase in the quantity and quality of the economic goods and services that a society produces”，确认动作对象或说明内容。留意连接标记“and”、“and”；回到原句判断它连接的是词语、短语还是分句。解析器标出的定语从句候选是“that a society produces”；先读被修饰的名词，再回看这部分补充说明。

sentences.text: It can be measured as the increase in the inflation-adjusted output of an economy in a given year or over a period of time.

sentences.readingHintZh: 先找主语候选“It”，再看句法中心“focuses”。

sentences.text: The rate of growth is typically calculated as real gross domestic product (GDP) growth rate, real GDP per capita growth rate, GNI per capita growth or median income growth.

sentences.text: The "rate" of economic growth refers to the geometric annual rate of growth in GDP or GDP per capita between the first and the last year over a period of time.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误
sentences.readingHintZh: 先找主语候选“The "rate" of economic growth”，再看句法中心“refers”。留意连接标记“or”、“and”；回到原句判断它连接的是词语、短语还是分句。

sentences.text: This growth rate represents the trend in the average level of GDP over the period, and ignores any fluctuations in the GDP around this trend.

sentences.text: Growth is usually calculated in "real" value, which is inflation-adjusted, to eliminate the distorting effect of inflation on the prices of goods produced.

sentences.readingHintZh: 先找主语候选“Growth”，再看句法中心“calculated”。把中心词与助动词、否定词或小品词一起读：“is”、“calculated”；这些词在原句中不一定连续。解析器标出的定语从句候选是“which is inflation-adjusted,”；先读被修饰的名词，再回看这部分补充说明。检测到被动结构标记；注意区分承受动作的人或事物与动作发出者。

sentences.text: Economists refer to economic growth caused by more efficient use of inputs (increased productivity of labor, of physical capital, of energy or of materials) as intensive growth.

sentences.text: In contrast, economic growth caused only by increases in the amount of inputs available for use (increased population, for example, or new territory) counts as extensive growth.
